description: Update an existing Global Traffic Manager policy

geoMapId.description: Geo/CIDR Map ID (required when lbType is GEOLOCATION or CIDR)

lbType.description: Load balancing type: ROUND_ROBIN | WEIGHTED_ROUND_ROBIN | GEOLOCATION | CIDR (same values as ncloud_gtm_get_lb_types). The legacy aliases GEO and WEIGHTED_RR are converted to GEOLOCATION and WEIGHTED_ROUND_ROBIN.

resourceGroups.description: Resource groups. For GEOLOCATION, include one group for EVERY detail of the map, including ETC (geoMapDetailId -1) — otherwise the API rejects the request with 'need all detail id'. PUBLIC_IP resources must be public IP addresses.

content.description: Resource value: an IP address for PUBLIC_IP, a domain name for EXTERNAL_DOMAIN

type.description: Resource type: PUBLIC_IP | EXTERNAL_DOMAIN (same values as ncloud_gtm_get_resource_types)

geoMapDetailId.description: Geo/CIDR map detail ID this group serves (only when lbType is GEOLOCATION or CIDR). IDs come from ncloud_gtm_get_geo_cidr_map_detail (detailedMapList[].id); the catch-all ETC detail is -1

name: ncloud_gtm_update_policy
